text.p: Lithuania's M1 Plus radio reported the following stories at midday on Thursday.

-- Lithuanian parliament rejected the veto of Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas on the procedures of appointment of the new prosecutor general. Seimas decided that a candidate to the post would be introduced for parliament's approval by the chairman of the supreme court and the minister of justice.
-- Lithuanian and Latvian negotiators meet in Riga today in hope of resuming negotiations over sea and economic zones in the Baltic sea. Talks between the two countries hit a wall five months ago.
-- Lithuanian Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius said he expected no changes in litas exchange rate.
